# How many gallons a week does your kombucha brewery have to sell to break even, and how much cash does the ramp-up eat?

> Free kombucha brewery profit calculator: fermenter capacity, batch cycle, wholesale and taproom prices, packaging, labour and rent become gallons a week, monthly profit, break-even, the cash reserve for ramp-up, loan coverage and payback. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/kombucha-brewery-profit-calculator/)
